Name: Furry Nude Girls
Author: Plebby999
Description:
A conversion to make [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued[/url] Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20277]Nude Girls[/url]. I also added a patch to help with some overlay compatibility issues and added more anthro character options from other mods.

[b]Installation:[/b]
Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]CMCT[/url].
Install all the requirements for ACC and Nude Girls.
Overwrite the portraits and sprites from Nude Girls with this mod.
